                             Upgrade your V2 agent configurations to V3 with /upgrade-agent
                                              https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/
                                Prefer the previous experience? Launch with kiro-cli --v2

                   Tip: Want a simpler, lighter-weight terminal with all the same features? Try /lite!


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 ▸ Kiro CLI 3.0 launches at the end of October. If you have auto-updates on, you'll be upgraded to 3.0 automatically.
   It brings cloud sessions, memory, workflows, an improved trust model, expanded hooks and specs.
   Note: 3.0 doesn't support the legacy --classic experience or the legacy desktop app.
